requirements.title: Plugin Registration
requirements.body: The plugin must export a valid OpenCode plugin via @opencode-ai/plugin that registers exactly 2 tools: model_prefs_list and model_prefs_set.

scenarios.title: Plugin loads and registers tools
given: the plugin is installed in opencode.json
then: the plugin registers without errors
tools model_prefs_list and model_prefs_set are available

requirements.title: model_prefs_list Tool
requirements.body: The model_prefs_list tool must return a segmented table listing all user-facing Agents, Sub-Agents, and loaded custom Slash-Commands, each with their current model mapping. Mappings show 'none' if not explicitly set. Hidden/system agents (compaction, title, summary) must be excluded.

scenarios.title: Lists agents with no mappings set
given: no model preferences are configured in global config
the session has agents: coder, plan, ask
then: output contains Agents section with coder, plan, ask
each shows model as 'none'
system agents compaction, title, summary are not listed

scenarios.title: Lists agents with existing mappings
given: global config has agent.coder.model set to 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514'
then: coder shows model as 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514'
other agents show 'none'

scenarios.title: Lists custom slash commands
given: custom commands 'deploy' and 'review' are loaded
then: output contains Slash-Commands section with deploy and review
built-in commands like help are not listed

scenarios.title: Segments output by type
given: agents, sub-agents, and commands all exist
then: output is segmented into Agents, Sub-Agents, and Slash-Commands sections

requirements.title: model_prefs_set Tool
requirements.body: The model_prefs_set tool must accept a target type (agent or command), target name, and model ID in provider/model format. It must write the mapping to global config (~/.config/opencode/opencode.json) immediately. It must validate that the model exists in the provider registry before writing.

scenarios.title: Sets agent model preference
given: agent 'coder' exists
model 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514' is available
scenarios.when: model_prefs_set is called with type='agent', name='coder', model='anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514'
then: global config is updated with agent.coder.model = 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514'
tool returns success confirmation

scenarios.title: Sets command model preference
given: command 'deploy' exists
model 'openai/gpt-4o' is available
scenarios.when: model_prefs_set is called with type='command', name='deploy', model='openai/gpt-4o'
then: global config is updated with command.deploy.model = 'openai/gpt-4o'
tool returns success confirmation

scenarios.title: Clears a model preference
given: agent 'coder' has a model mapping set
scenarios.when: model_prefs_set is called with type='agent', name='coder', model='none'
then: the agent.coder.model field is removed from global config
tool returns confirmation that preference was cleared

scenarios.title: Rejects invalid model
given: model 'fake/nonexistent-model' does not exist in any provider
then: tool returns an error message
global config is not modified
error includes the invalid model name

requirements.title: Global Config Persistence
requirements.body: All model preference mappings must be stored in and read from the global OpenCode config file (~/.config/opencode/opencode.json). Writes must use jsonc-parser to preserve JSONC formatting (comments, trailing commas). The plugin must never use client.config.update() which targets project config.

scenarios.title: Writes preserve JSONC formatting
given: global config contains comments and trailing commas
then: existing comments are preserved
existing formatting is maintained
the new field is added with consistent indentation

scenarios.title: Config file is created if missing
given: no global config file exists at ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
then: the config file is created with proper JSON structure
the mapping is written correctly

requirements.title: Slash Command Dialog
requirements.body: The /model-preferences slash command must instruct the AI to orchestrate an interactive dialog using model_prefs_list for display, the question tool for selections, and model_prefs_set for persistence. The flow is: list all targets, let user select a row, show available models, let user pick, persist, and loop until user exits.

scenarios.title: Command triggers model listing
given: the plugin is installed
then: AI calls model_prefs_list
AI presents the segmented list to the user

scenarios.title: User can select and set a model
given: the model preferences list is displayed
scenarios.when: user selects an agent row and picks a model
then: AI calls model_prefs_set with the selection
AI confirms the mapping was saved
AI offers to continue or exit

requirements.title: No Silent Fallback on Invalid Model
requirements.body: When a mapped model is invalid or unavailable at runtime, OpenCode's native ModelNotFoundError must block execution. The plugin must not implement custom validation that silently falls back to a default model. The native error includes fuzzy suggestions for correction.

scenarios.title: Invalid model blocks agent execution
given: agent 'coder' is mapped to 'anthropic/deleted-model' which no longer exists
then: execution is blocked
error message includes the invalid model name
error message includes fuzzy suggestions

requirements.title: Agent Filtering
requirements.body: The model_prefs_list tool must exclude hidden/system agents from the listing. Specifically, agents named compaction, title, and summary must be filtered out. All other agents (built-in user-facing and user-defined) must be included and correctly categorized as Agent or Sub-Agent based on their mode field.

scenarios.title: System agents excluded
given: session has agents: coder, plan, compaction, title, summary
then: coder and plan are listed
compaction, title, and summary are not listed

scenarios.title: Agents categorized by mode
given: agent 'coder' has mode 'primary'
agent 'explore' has mode 'subagent'
then: coder appears in Agents section
explore appears in Sub-Agents section
